title: embryo-vc-bench: a preregistered, zero-wet-lab virtual-cell benchmark for early human embryo atlases
description: Code and source data for a preregistered, zero-wet-lab benchmark of zero-shot single-cell foundation-model representations in early human embryo atlases. Frozen preregistered scores, mandatory naive baselines, permutation nulls, orthogonal validation, a reproducible release bundle and post hoc negative controls are included. No wet-lab experiment was performed; the shared latent developmental time axis was never fitted; H2 is reported as not confirmed as a uniform null, with partial evidence against, and not formally falsified. OSF preregistration: 10.17605/OSF.IO/8TZRQ.
